apps.title: keyd
apps.tagline: evdev remap - the layer beneath every bind
apps.description: keyd remaps at the evdev level, below XKB and Wayland, so it applies in every session - niri and GNOME alike, even on the login screen's seat. Every Ctrl in this manual is the Caps Lock key held; every Esc is the Caps Lock key tapped. The vi-style grammar of the whole system stands on this.

groups.name: Caps Lock: tap Escape, hold Control

bindings.label: Tap: Escape · hold or chord: Control

groups.description: One key, two jobs: release it within the tap timeout (Global settings below) and it is Esc; hold it, or press any other key while it is down, and it is Control. Plain overload, not the delayed overloadt variants: the layer activates instantly on keydown, so fast chords - tmux's prefix is Ctrl+Space - can never race the tap/hold decision into a stuck Escape.

groups.name: Physical Ctrl keycap

bindings.label: Sends a real Caps Lock (OS toggle + LED)

groups.description: Caps Lock's new job needs its old one to live somewhere: the left Ctrl keycap becomes the real Caps Lock (raw keycode to the OS/XKB toggle, LED included). Esc keeps its own key.

groups.name: Global settings

bindings.label: Escape fires only when the overloaded key was held for less than this many ms

groups.description: The tap window that separates Escape from Control on overloaded keys; the live value rides in the command column.

apps.title: niri
apps.description: The global layer: everything works from the vi home row, and modifiers compose — Shift moves instead of focusing, Ctrl takes the column along, Alt is the floating exception. Mod = Super. Binds are declared from scratch here, so stock niri assignments (like Mod+Q = close) do not exist. In-app overlay: this config skips it at startup; use this site instead.

groups.description: The system's settings live in keyboard menus, not apps: Mod+Shift plus the initial opens a hardware menu as a fuzzel dmenu loop, Mod+P the session menu (P = power), Mod+Shift+U the system-ops menu.

Floating is the config's one Alt bind - plain Mod+S stays deliberately unbound; do not rebind it without asking Stefan first.

groups.description: Two spellings for the same three actions: the Print family for boards that have the key, the G cluster (G = grab) for boards without. bindings.label: Arm or disarm clipboard recording (cliprec menu)

groups.description: Recording is opt-in: nothing watches the clipboard by default, so secrets are never silently archived. Arm it for a chosen lifetime, recall while armed. History is wiped at session start and on lock/suspend.

groups.description: Two roads to lock: the GNOME-style chord and the one-hand Mod+Escape. Locking runs swaylock and wipes the clipboard history. Idle handling: swayidle locks after 15 min, powers monitors off after 20. Sleep/reboot live in the session menu (Mod+P).

apps.title: waybar
apps.description: The bar is deliberately thin: workspace dots at the left edge, status chips in the right pill. The chips mirror the keyboard layer - the language chip click is Mod+Space, the bell click is Mod+Shift+N - so the pointer path and the key path always agree.

groups.name: Left edge: workspace dots
groups.description: Each workspace paints a 10px dot in its identity colour; focus stretches it into a pill, urgent workspaces breathe, empty ones stay visible (1-3 are persistent by niri config). Scrolling walks the strip.

groups.name: Right pill: bell · language · volume · clock

bindings.label: Bell: toggle the swaync control center (history + actions)

Clock: toggle local time ⇄ UTC (the zone abbreviation is the cue)

groups.description: The notification bell shows toasts as a glyph + count (grey under do-not-disturb). Click handlers run with a bare PATH, which is why the module pins absolute store paths.

apps.title: qutebrowser
apps.description: Daily driver (Mod+Q in niri), Nord-themed, with Brave-ABP + StevenBlack host blocking and pass-store logins. Customs hide behind the , leader so the stock vocabulary (J/K tabs, d close, f hints, H/L history, gg/G) stays untouched; case is the binding - ;j is not ,J. The full stock reference follows.
